label: Run 13 · all 3 chats
note: Every chat of run 13 (run 12 with the turn no longer fixed at one message from each): the same pair, the same brief and the same prompt, each written by a different writer. All of them were written improvisation by improvisation to the same instructions, under IMPROVISATIONS. What the instructions fix (how each improvisation goes, the traps, how interest moves) is shared by design and is not a template; only what the writers made of it can differ.

chat.variety.why: All three chats follow the same night in the same order. Each opens with Reuben's hat-and-monocle flattery and a swap of disclosures about the 4.5-inch curve and the bump or ridge. Then come the Marguerite calendar fights and the crying-in-a-cab story, a denial of being a shut-in or of rehearsing (Turn 3, Turn 7), live narration of his own collapse with Brick saying 'stop narrating' (Turn 5 and Turn 8 Spiral), and a timestamped booking with a calendar invite accepted (Turn 11). Specific lines recur well beyond what the shared instructions fix: 'four seconds flat' and 'leaving the top hat at home' close two chats, 'monocle just fogged' appears in two, and 'dishwasher-safe' kanji, the $340 steamer, the plastic cocktail sword and 'eleven days' each appear in two. It sits below a 3 because the endings are near-identical too, and the real differences are local (Booster's explicit fear confession, Wong's early Reuben-led itinerary, Carr's Brick-written schedule) rather than different nights.
